goal: Improve the text output of `formatText()` in `src/flow/commands/report.js` by removing a section that is always meaningless at report generation time, clarifying ambiguous metric labels, reducing clutter in the Issue Log, and ensuring the Tests section is always present.

in: No changes to `generateReport()`, `aggregateMetrics()`, `saveReport()`, or the `data` object structure
out: Changes to callers of `generateReport()` (finalize, issue comment)

acceptance_criteria: AC1: Text output does not contain the string `Documents`.
AC2: Metrics line contains `docs read`, `src read`, and `issue-log` (not `docs`, `src`, or `issues` as standalone labels).
AC3: Issue log entries appear as `[step] reason` with no `->` suffix.
AC4: Text output always contains the string `Tests`, even when no test data exists.
AC5: Existing `generateReport()` behavior (data structure, other text sections) is unchanged.

clarifications.q: Does removing the Documents section affect `report.json`?
clarifications.a: No. `data.sync` remains in the data object; only the text rendering is removed.

clarifications.q: Should Issue Log still be hidden when there are no entries?

alternatives_considered.reason: Show "n/a" instead of removing — Rejected. Always-skipped content adds noise with no benefit.
Add `--verbose` flag for full resolution display — Rejected. `report.json` already provides full data; text output is for quick human review.
